title: Acne Treatment Algorithm
subtitle: Comedonal, inflammatory, nodulocystic, and special populations

steps.prompt: Are nodules, cysts, scarring, severe truncal acne, or major psychosocial distress present?
Pregnant, trying pregnancy, or avoiding teratogenic agents?
Topical retinoid + benzoyl peroxide as tolerated
Moderate/widespread inflammatory disease or truncal involvement?
Topical retinoid + benzoyl peroxide ± topical antibiotic
Add limited-duration oral antibiotic or hormonal therapy when appropriate

citations.quote: AAD acne guideline: strong recommendations for benzoyl peroxide, topical retinoids, topical antibiotics, oral doxycycline, and oral isotretinoin for severe acne.
AAD acne guideline hub provides the current management guideline and implementation resources for acne vulgaris.
